objective: 100% measured feasibility first; then median24D, P25, P10, lower MDD, mean, lower turnover
question: Can broader independent sampling and balanced structural/entry strata find any fully feasible 24-session candidate without changing the engine or measured rules?
hypothesis: Earlier random and local samples missed a feasible permitted interaction among structural, replacement and entry parameters.
alternative: Corporate-action uncertainty and daily allocation constraints dominate all permitted parameter choices; additional search produces no admissible strategy.

search.strata: 20 target_count x max_replacements_per_day cells in declared SPACE order; first16 cells13 draws, final4 cells12 draws; deterministic cycling across every declared entry threshold level within each cell; remaining parameters uniform
search.reference: Previous expansion new-candidate DEVELOPMENT leader only; no holdout/recent/validation ranking used for generation

selection: 100% measured pass and completeness on ALL development and validation; validation median/P25 not worse than baseline; momentum +/-0.05 stability; official unknowns remain blocked
diagnostic_policy: Failed bottleneck candidates may fill diagnostic shortlist, never adopted. One known development failure proves inadmissibility, not an aggregate return estimate.
stop_condition: One predeclared 512-candidate expansion; stop on engineering/audit error; freeze after validation; no holdout or recent tuning. If no fully feasible candidate exists, preserve baseline and report no qualified replacement.
prior_exposure: Validation reused for model selection; historical holdout and recent already exposed in earlier rounds, isolated from this search but not pristine.
post_freeze: 23 holdout monthly,20 recent monthly,16 seasonal analogues; last126 complete rolling starts for baseline and new diagnostic leader. Overlap is not independent.
